articles.views.approve_article(request, pk)[source]¶

Approve an article. Restricted to the Editor group (or superusers). This is the view-level access control required by the brief; the actual “email subscribers + POST to /api/approved/” side effects are handled by the post_save signal in articles/signals.py (Option 1).

Models¶

Core content models for the News Application.

This module defines Publisher, Article, and Newsletter models.

The models use normalised Django relationships, including foreign keys and many-to-many relationships, to connect publishers, users, articles, and newsletters without duplicating data.
